svg.text: Fish market S14 -- one big one-way ring (roads: dry layout, solved; buildings + new quay line: proposal)
North up, 50 m grid. Every lane drawn from the dry layout's EXPORTED lanes at its own width, arrows = direction of travel (right-hand). Buildings, bays and the quay line are the step-2 proposal.

S14 step 1 (2026-10-14): the roads are a DRY layout of tools/island_site_access.py (nothing built); measured on the exported lanes:
1. Truck ramp unchanged; at its foot a level R 20 left bend due south onto J, an unsignalled 4-arm junction, every arm square.
2. Ring: one-way 2 x 3.5 m, counter-clockwise. In = straight on from the ramp's down lanes (R 88); out = a right turn up the ramp (R 11.3).
3. J's exit mouths are held at 17.5 m (at 12 m the right turn out was R 6.2, no truck's turn); J moved 4 m south (z 770), other mouths 13.4 m.
4. Inside lane of every ring corner R >= 13.3 (the end loop R ~16); ramp-foot bend inside lane R 14.3. Public arm west to the car park: cars only (its turns R 6).
5. South leg's outer edge z 803.3 -> 9 parallel bays (z 803.5-807) + forklift strip (807-810) -> row from z 810: hall 100 x 16 (to 826, x 345-445), others 12 m (to 822).
6. Wangan piers 2.0-2.7 m wide at z 826-837 stand in the apron, 3-15 m off the row; deck (y 17.6) over the cold store / ice plant / hall's east end.
